risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/bootstrap.ts is unregistered, so RV2). The HTTP entry sets routerOptions.maxParamLength to 384 (three times the contract's longest path parameter, ProductKey maxLength 128, leaving room for percent-encoding). Before, Fastify's default 100 answered 414 outside the contract ErrorEnvelope for 101–128 character product keys; now a contract-valid key reaches its route and an over-long key is refused by the route schema with 20001. Placed under routerOptions because the top-level option is deprecated (FSTDEP022 on stderr broke the entry smoke check on the first container run). No contract, database or money change.
